Theorem (part 1, DH-invariance): every axiom in A holds verbatim with the coefficients of zeta replaced by those of the Davenport-Heilbronn series (same frequency set {log n}, l-infinity-bounded coefficients); hence no statement derivable in the LP-closure of A distinguishes zeta from DH — in particular no such derivation can exclude even one off-line zero (S1/S2 fail at the AXIOM level, not the estimate level). Theorem (part 2, internal supremum): the supremum of zero-location output over the LP-closure of A augmented by its own terminal conjectures (Montgomery large-values; all-moment Lindelof bounds) is exactly {Density Hypothesis A(sigma) <= 2} + {Vinogradov-Korobov-shape zero-free regions via the (1-sigma)^{3/2} exponent}, i.e. Lindelof-type mean-value control and nothing stronger — with the sigma <= 3/4 decoupling-only case already capped unconditionally by Guth's almost-counterexample (2503.07410 §5.5). Deliverables: part 1 is a finite audit of where multiplicativity enters each axiom's proof (nowhere) and is the branch's entry in the no-go library; part 2 is the decoupling analogue of the program's formalized bandwidth ceiling and becomes the 'known ceiling' clause of A4's brief.

reports.first_interface: Monoid-form DH-exclusion theorem (the S1 axiom in its sharpest formal home, referee-evaluable, positivity-free): Let D(s) be the Davenport-Heilbronn series (respectively the Epstein zeta of a class-number>1 binary quadratic form), which satisfies a self-dual functional equation — Epstein's even arising from genuine lattice Poisson summation. THEOREM TO PROVE, effectively and with a trace-formula certificate, via the Blomer-Leung beyond-endoscopy converse mechanism (Adv. Math. 471 (2026) 110716): there is no isobaric automorphic representation Pi of GL_n(A_Q) (n <= 3) and no representation rho of the L-group with D(s) = L(s, Pi, rho); concretely, the Kuznetsov/elliptic-part Poisson average that characterizes automorphy vanishes on automorphic coefficient data but is explicitly nonzero on D's data, the obstruction localizing at the primes where D violates Hecke multiplicativity — equivalently, D admits no BK/Ngo monoid family membership (no Euler-factorized Hankel kernel reproducing its functional equation). Corollary fixing this branch's role under the spec: 'membership in a rho-Poisson monoid family' is an axiom DH/Epstein violate (S1 anchor consumable by every other program direction), while the branch's own maximal outputs (FE + continuation + pole data at s=1 + GRC-type bounds) are either DH-shared or edge-locked — so the branch supplies the RH-relevant input axiom but provably not the deciding inequality.
